description.value: Papi's Seafood and Oyster Bar is a casual seafood restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, situated steps from the English Bay Seawall with a heated outdoor patio offering panoramic water views. The interior draws on Greek mythology, anchored by a full-wall mural of the sea goddess Amphitrite painted by local artists Arden Marow Ross and Peter Ricq. Part of the award-winning Viaggio Hospitality group, the restaurant focuses on fresh Pacific Northwest catches paired with sea-inspired cocktails.
